title: 第14章 来自巨石城的奸商
content_zh:
楚光很走运，这一路上并没有碰到难以应对的危险。
不止如此。
当他走到贝特街附近的时候，正好看见从巨石城来的商队在贝特街的门口卸货。
背着猎枪的沃特老头，站在一旁抽着他那杆自制的旱烟，老查理正和商队的领袖愉快交谈，旁边帮闲的拾荒者则是在枪手的监视下卸货。
商队领袖叫李总，名字不知道，楚光只知道他是从巨石城来的，手下有八个枪手，二十来头变异牦牛。
每隔段时间，他会带着人和畜生来贝特街贩卖一些物资，同时收走这里的“特产”。
在废土上，尤其是城区里，车没有畜生靠谱。
满公路都是抛锚的废车和倒塌的废墟，再加上大量的公路疏于维护，表面皲裂严重，甚至钻出了植被的根茎，大多数轮式载具根本走不动。
相比之下，驴子，牛，马都是好东西，它们虽然走不快，但几乎没有它们走不了的路。
最关键的是价格低廉，维护简单，百公里三十斤草。
科技并不是任何时候都靠谱，至少在这里。
当然，如果是跨行省的长途跋涉，那又是另一种情况了。
楚光曾经见过一种半轮半履带的货车，上面还伫立着烟囱般粗的炮管，颇有朋克艺术内味儿。
但这种体积笨重的货车一般不会开进城里，通常都是在城外卸货，与活跃在附近地区的中小型商队交易，完事儿了就走。
楚光注意到，这次运往贝特街的物资里面，居然还有一个裹着长袍的女人。
她的手脚戴着镣铐，脚踝上印着条纹码，细腻洁白的肌肤不像是废土上的幸存者，更像是从电影中走出的精灵。
或者说，由培养皿培育出来的“商品”。
“克隆人？”
之前楚光只是听说过，巨石城有奴隶贸易，但还是第一次亲眼见到。不过这种“奢侈品”，想来也只有那位镇长大人才能消费的起了。
楚光没有立刻上前，而是在废墟的阴影下安静地等待交易完成。

“牛仔”们都很忙，没有在这儿停留。
装完货之后，那位李总将手伸进怀里，摸出几枚白色的筹码，像打发要饭的一样，扔给帮闲的拾荒者们。
然后，他便在一片感恩戴德地恭维声中，和枪手们一道，赶着满载大包小包的变异牦牛们上了路。
楚光远远地跟在后面，走过了两条街。
然而这时，跟在那个李总旁边的男人忽然停下脚步，目光笔直地看向了他这边。
被发现的楚光心中微微一惊。
这中间至少隔着百米，这家伙是怎么发现自己的？！
不过，既然已经被发现了，在后面跟着也就没了意义。
楚光从废墟中走了出来，先是抬起双手示意自己没有恶意，接着拎着黑色塑料袋走了过去。
隔着十米的距离，他在一处斜歪着的咖啡厅招牌下，停住了脚步。
对于双方而言，这都是最安全的距离。
如果发生冲突，自己贴身穿着的那件碳纳米防弹衣，足够为自己逃跑争取至少五秒的时间。
只要不被爆头……
“我没有恶意，只是想和你们做笔交易。”
那个叫李总的男人眯了眯眼，将手中的霰弹枪扛在肩上。
“你是贝特街的拾荒者？”
“楚光。”
“我不关心你叫什么，而且我们也不做小买卖，”男人用戏谑的眼神看着他手上的塑料袋，“这点东西，你还是扔给你们那个叫查理的老头比较好。”
楚光没有说话，拉开了塑料袋，露出了装在里面的货。
男人明显是识货的，他脸上的表情一滞，显然没想到这塑料袋里装着的居然不是废旧零件和电池，而是这种好东西。

楚光注意到，他的眼中闪过一丝不易察觉的贪婪。
“你从哪儿弄来的？”男人问道。
楚光看着他，不动声色道。
“下水道，变异水蛭巢穴的旁边，但就算我告诉你在哪，你愿意去么。”
“只是随口一问，别介意。”
眼中贪婪的神色收敛了几分，男人将手中的霰弹枪递给了自己的随从，走到楚光的面前。
“你打算怎么卖？”
贝特街的回收价格是每50g一点筹码，但这玩意儿的真实价值绝对不止这么点！
楚光沉默了两秒，决定赌一把，按照贝特街回收站价格的五倍报价。
“这里有2000g，我要200点筹码！”
“成交。”
看着男人只是稍作犹豫便一口答应了下来，楚光立刻意识到，自己的报价还是报便宜了。
果然，这狗曰的镇长卖给这些商人们的价格，肯定不止这么点！
这帮吃人不吐骨头的水蛭！
楚光在心里默默地把镇长和他家人们全都问候了一遍，祝他今天晚上硬不起来。
“交个朋友吧，我叫李斯特。”
男人伸出右手，一扫先前傲慢的态度，脸上也露出了笑容，“我很少直接和拾荒者做生意，但你是个例外……我对你很感兴趣。”
楚光不卑不亢，握住他的手晃了晃。
“谢谢，我叫楚光。”
“我知道，你刚才说过。”

松开手，李斯特盯着楚光，继续说道，“那么首先，我希望今天我们交易的事情，不会被那个叫查理的老头知道。”
楚光说道。
“他当然不会知道，我也不想惹麻烦。”
“哈哈，你是个聪明人。”
很满意楚光的回答，李斯特微笑着点了点头，继续说道。
“我现在就可以支付给你200点筹码，不过……反正这些筹码你也是拿去换东西，不如直接在我这里买，还省得被中间商赚差价。这里还有些剩下的物资，我可以算你八折，如何？”
楚光没有信他的那句所谓八折的鬼话，反正他也不可能知道这些牛背上的货物在巨石城卖多少钱。
不过，只要他卖的比贝特街便宜，自己就没有拒绝的理由。
“我需要武器，你有吗？”
“当然有，你要哪一种？”
“枪。”
“枪是吗？”李斯特摸了摸下巴，“9mm口径的栓动式铁管步枪如何？只需要200点筹码，我可以送你30发子弹。额外购买子弹的话，1点筹码1颗，这个价格绝对公道。”
“打八折？”
“这已经是八折了，如果你要是嫌贵，我这里当然还有便宜的，比如价值100点筹码的铁管手枪，口径5mm，对付掠夺者还是很好用的，但不是很推荐用来对付异种。”
已经是八折了还行。
我信你个鬼！
楚光盯着他，说。
“一把9mm的栓动式铁管步枪再加60发子弹。除此之外，我还要20……不，25点筹码购买食物和其他补给。”
看着一脸不以为然耸肩的李斯特，楚光用认真的语气继续说道。
“变异水蛭的巢穴里可不止2公斤蘑菇，但我只能采到巢穴附近的……你明白我的意思吗？”

“你想让我投资你？”李斯特饶有兴趣地看着楚光，“有趣。”
楚光不为所动说道。
“为什么不呢？我敢打赌，即使是按照这个价格，你仍然能赚不少。而且如果你答应我，我下次可以带来的货，将是今天的十倍！你难道不心动么？”
李斯特心动了。
老实说，这确实是个不错的提议。
将这两公斤的蓝伞菇驼到巨石城，别说是一把栓动式的铁管步枪，就是十把都买到了。
这些生活在远郊的乡巴佬根本不知道，抗辐剂和消辐剂对于生活在城里的人们来说意味着什么。
好东西，可都藏在那些核弹坑附近！
“一般来说，很少有人能从我的手中拿走筹码。”
李斯特给自己的助手使了个眼色，让他去旁边的变异牦牛身上取下一把铁管步枪和60发子弹。
“你是个例外。”
从兜里数出了25枚白色筹码，李斯特将它和那些货，一起递到了楚光的手上。
“20公斤的蓝伞菇是么，就当是投资吧，我等你的消息。”
“月底我还会来一次这里，而且不出意外应该是今年最后一次。”
“希望那时候能见到你。”
变异水蛭。
没有人愿意招惹那东西。
只有上帝知道那玩意儿的巢穴里到底藏着多少只恶心的臭虫，而且最要命的是，寻常的贯穿式火力在他们面前根本不顶用。
恐怖的再生能力和生命力，让它们即使是被从中间切断，也能在短暂的挣扎后分裂成两个新的个体，更别说在身上开几个小孔。
至于放火……

不说能不能点着，就算点着了，也会把值钱的东西一起烧掉。
完全得不偿失。
“对了，二十公斤的蓝伞菇，我就算你2000点筹码好了，你可以在我这里订货，没必要捡别人挑剩下的。”
看着摆弄着手中武器的楚光，李斯特提醒道。
楚光停下了手上的动作，看着他问。
“我如何知道你有什么货。”
李斯特打了个响指。
他身旁那人会意，递来了一张四四方方的平板电脑。
“上面有照片，左右滑动挑选……你会用我就不教你了。我保证这些货的质量都是没问题的，但不保证你实际收到的货物和照片看起来一模一样。”
接过平板的楚光粗略扫了两眼，发现这上面的好东西还真不少。
尤其是他看见了自己最需要的东西。
“选好了吗？”看着挑选中的楚光，李斯特催促道。
“选好了，”将平板还了回去，楚光看着他说道，“10KW功率的木柴发电机，以及KV-1动力外骨骼。”
“你的眼光不错，KV-1虽然是基础款，但也是最耐用的一款，不过你要发电机做什么？担心把电用完不如多买几块电池，我这里提供以旧换新服务，非常便宜。”
发电机可不便宜，一台就得1200点筹码。
相比之下，KV-1动力外骨骼只需要800点筹码就足够了，一块配套的化学能电池也就150筹码的事儿。
换一块电池再贵，也花不到一千多。
而且这玩意儿买了，他打算放哪里呢？
外骨骼还能穿在衣服里面，发电机这种东西，可不是一名普通的拾荒者能买得起的。
看穿了李斯特的顾虑，楚光说道。

“放心，我不会把它带回贝特街。”
“我只是随口一问，你怎么处理它与我无关，反正就算你说是我卖给你的，我也不会承认，最后倒霉的还是你自己。”李斯特耸了耸肩，看了一眼不远处的天色，“时间不早了，后会有期。”
楚光叫住了他。
“等等，我想问下，我刚才订购的那些东西打八折么。”
李斯特哈哈笑了笑，头也不回地挥了下手。
“你看的价格，就是打折后的。”
楚光：“……%￥#￥%”
你大爷的！
看老子以后怎么宰你们这帮奸商！
目送着商队走远，楚光黑着脸也转身离开了。
content_en:
Chu Guang was lucky, and he did not encounter any dangers that were difficult to deal with along the way.
It's more than that.
When he walked near Beit Street, he happened to see the caravan from Boulder City unloading goods at the entrance of Beit Street.
Old Walter, who was carrying a shotgun, stood aside smoking his homemade dry cigarette. Old Charlie was happily chatting with the leader of the caravan, and the scavengers who were helping nearby were unloading goods under the surveillance of the gunmen.
The leader of the caravan is Mr. Li. His name is unknown. Chu Guang only knows that he is from Boulder City. He has eight gunmen and about twenty mutant yaks.
Every once in a while, he would bring people and animals to Beit Street to sell some supplies, and at the same time collect the "specialties" here.
In the wasteland, especially in urban areas, cars are not as reliable as animals.
The roads are full of broken down vehicles and collapsed ruins. In addition, a large number of roads are neglected to maintain. The surface is seriously cracked and even the roots of vegetation are drilled out. Most wheeled vehicles cannot move at all.
In comparison, donkeys, cows, and horses are all good things. Although they can't walk fast, there is almost no road they can't walk.
The most important thing is that the price is low, maintenance is simple, and only 30 pounds of grass per 100 kilometers is used.
Technology is not always reliable, at least here.
Of course, if it is a long journey across provinces, it is another situation.
Chu Guang once saw a truck with half wheels and half tracks, with a gun barrel as thick as a chimney standing on it, which had a punk art feel.
However, such bulky trucks generally do not drive into the city. They usually unload their goods outside the city, trade with small and medium-sized caravans active in nearby areas, and leave as soon as they are done.
Chu Guang noticed that among the supplies shipped to Beit Street this time, there was actually a woman wrapped in a robe.
Her hands and feet were shackled, and there were strip codes printed on her ankles. Her delicate and white skin did not look like a survivor in the wasteland, but more like an elf walking out of a movie.
In other words, "commodities" grown in petri dishes.
"Clone?"
Chu Guang had only heard about the slave trade in Boulder City before, but this was the first time he saw it with his own eyes. However, this kind of "luxury" can only be consumed by the mayor.
Chu Guang did not step forward immediately, but quietly waited for the transaction to be completed in the shadow of the ruins.
The "cowboys" were too busy to stop here.
After loading the goods, Mr. Li reached into his arms, took out a few white chips, and threw them to the helping scavengers like he was sending away beggars.
Then, amidst the grateful compliments, he and the gunmen drove the mutated yaks loaded with large and small bags onto the road.
Chu Guang followed from a distance and walked two streets.
However, at this moment, the man following Mr. Li suddenly stopped and looked straight at him.
Chu Guang was slightly shocked when he was discovered.
There was at least a hundred meters between them. How did this guy find himself? !
However, now that it has been discovered, there is no point in following him.
Chu Guang walked out of the ruins, first raised his hands to show that he had no ill intentions, and then walked over carrying a black plastic bag.
Ten meters away, he stopped under a leaning cafe sign.
This is the safest distance for both parties.
If a conflict occurs, the carbon nanobody armor he wears next to his body is enough to buy him at least five seconds to escape.
As long as you don't get shot in the head...
"I have no ill intentions, I just want to make a deal with you."
The man named Mr. Li narrowed his eyes and put the shotgun on his shoulder.
"Are you a ragpicker from Beit Street?"
"Chu Guang."
"I don't care what your name is, and we don't do small business," the man looked at the plastic bag in his hand with a joking look, "you'd better throw this thing to your old man named Charlie."
Chu Guang didn't sayThen, he opened the plastic bag and revealed the goods inside.
The man obviously knew the goods, and the expression on his face was stagnant. He obviously didn't expect that the plastic bag contained not used parts and batteries, but such good things.
Chu Guang noticed that there was a trace of imperceptible greed in his eyes.
"Where did you get it?" the man asked.
Chu Guang looked at him and said calmly.
"The sewer, next to the mutated leech nest, but even if I tell you where it is, are you willing to go?"
"Just a casual question, don't mind."
The greedy look in his eyes dimmed a bit. The man handed the shotgun in his hand to his follower and walked up to Chu Guang.
"How are you going to sell it?"
The recycling price at Beit Street is one chip per 50g, but the real value of this thing is definitely more than that!
Chu Guang was silent for two seconds and decided to take a gamble and quote five times the price of the Beit Street recycling bin.
"There are 2000g here, I want 200 chips!"
"Deal."
Seeing that the man only hesitated for a moment and then agreed, Chu Guang immediately realized that his price was too low.
Sure enough, the price that the lousy mayor sold to these businessmen must be more than that!
These leeches eat people without spitting out their bones!
Chu Guang silently greeted the mayor and his family in his heart, wishing him not to get hard tonight.
"Make a friend, my name is Liszt."
The man stretched out his right hand, brushing away his previous arrogant attitude, and a smile appeared on his face, "I rarely do business directly with scavengers, but you are an exception... I am very interested in you."
Chu Guang was neither humble nor arrogant, so he held his hand and shook it.
"Thank you, my name is Chu Guang."
"I know, you just said that."
Liszt let go of his hand, stared at Chu Guang, and continued, "Well, first of all, I hope that the old man named Charlie will not know about our transaction today."
Chu Guang said.
"Of course he won't know, and I don't want to cause trouble."
"Haha, you are a smart man."
Very satisfied with Chu Guang's answer, Liszt nodded with a smile and continued.
"I can pay you 200 chips right now, but... you are going to use these chips to exchange for things anyway. Why not buy them directly from me, and avoid having to pay the difference to the middlemen. There are some supplies left here, and I can give you a 20% discount, how about that?"
Chu Guang didn't believe his lie about the 20% discount. Anyway, he couldn't possibly know how much the goods on the backs of the cows were selling for in Boulder City.
However, as long as he sells it cheaper than Beit Street, he has no reason to refuse.
"I need a weapon, do you have one?"
"Of course, which one do you want?"
"Gun."
"Is that a gun?" Lister touched his chin, "How about a 9mm caliber bolt-action iron tube rifle? You only need 200 chips, and I can give you 30 rounds of bullets. If you buy additional bullets, it's 1 chip for 1 point. This price is absolutely fair."
"Twenty percent off?"
"This is already a 20% discount. If you think it's expensive, of course I have cheaper ones here, such as an iron pipe pistol worth 100 chips, with a caliber of 5mm. It's still very useful against predators, but it's not highly recommended for dealing with alien species."
It’s already 20% off, which is okay.
I believe you!
Chu Guang stared at him and said.
"A 9mm bolt-action iron barrel rifle plus 60 rounds of ammunition. In addition, I also need 20...no, 25 chips to buy food and other supplies."
Looking at Liszt who shrugged with disapproval, Chu Guang continued in a serious tone.
"There are more than 2 kilograms of mushrooms in the mutated leech's nest, but I can only collect those near the nest... Do you understand what I mean?"
"You want me to invest in you?" Liszt looked at Chu Guang with interest, "Interesting."
Chu Guang said unmoved."Why not? I bet that even at this price, you can still make a lot of money. And if you promise me, the goods I can bring next time will be ten times as much as today! Aren't you excited?"
Liszt was moved.
Honestly, it's not a bad offer.
I brought these two kilograms of blue mushrooms to Boulder City and bought ten of them, not to mention a bolt-action iron tube rifle.
These country bumpkins living in the outer suburbs have no idea what anti-radiation agents and anti-radiation agents mean to people living in the city.
Good things are hidden near those nuclear craters!
"Generally speaking, there are very few people who can take the chips away from me."
Lister winked at his assistant and asked him to take out an iron pipe rifle and 60 rounds of ammunition from the mutated yak next to him.
"You are an exception."
Liszt counted 25 white chips from his pocket and handed them to Chu Guang's hand along with the goods.
"What about 20 kilograms of blue mushrooms? Just think of it as an investment. I'm waiting for your news."
"I will come here again at the end of the month, and if nothing else, it will be the last time this year."
"I hope I can see you then."
Mutated leeches.
No one wants to mess with that thing.
Only God knows how many disgusting bugs are hidden in that thing's lair, and the most terrible thing is that ordinary penetrating firepower is useless in front of them.
The terrifying regeneration ability and vitality allow them to split into two new individuals after a brief struggle even if they are cut in the middle, not to mention opening a few small holes in their bodies.
As for setting fire...
Regardless of whether it can be lit, even if it is lit, valuable things will be burned together.
Totally worth the loss.
"By the way, I'll give you 2,000 chips for 20 kilograms of blue mushrooms. You can order from me. There's no need to pick up what others picked out."
Looking at Chu Guang playing with the weapon in his hand, Liszt reminded him.
Chu Guang stopped what he was doing, looked at him and asked.
"How do I know what you have?"
Liszt snapped his fingers.
The man next to him understood and handed over a square tablet.
"There are photos on it, swipe left and right to choose... If you know how to use it, I won't teach you. I guarantee that the quality of these goods is no problem, but I don't guarantee that the goods you actually receive will look exactly the same as the photos."
Chu Guang took the tablet and took a quick glance at it, realizing that there were quite a lot of good things on it.
Especially when he saw what he needed most.
"Have you made your choice?" Liszt urged as he looked at Chu Guang who was making the selection.
"Okay," Chu Guang returned the tablet and said, looking at him, "a 10KW wood generator and a KV-1 powered exoskeleton."
"You have a good sense. Although KV-1 is a basic model, it is also the most durable one. But what do you need a generator for? If you are worried about running out of power, you might as well buy a few more batteries. I provide a trade-in service here, which is very cheap."
Generators are not cheap, one costs 1,200 points.
In comparison, the KV-1 powered exoskeleton only requires 800 chips, and a matching chemical energy battery only costs 150 chips.
No matter how expensive it is to replace a battery, it will cost less than a thousand.
And after buying this thing, where is he going to put it?
The exoskeleton can also be worn under clothes, and things like generators are not something that an ordinary scavenger can afford.
Chu Guang said after seeing through Liszt's concerns.
"Don't worry, I won't take it back to Beit Street."
"I'm just asking casually. How you deal with it has nothing to do with me. Anyway, even if you say I sold it to you, I won't admit it. In the end, you will be the unlucky one." Liszt shrugged and glanced at the sky not far away. "It's getting late. There will be more later.Expect. "
Chu Guang stopped him.
